title: hedyotis purpurea var. calycosa
intro: Hedyotis purpurea var. calycosa, commonly known as Wild Pink or Purple-fruited Hedyotis, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in North America. The health benefits of Hedyotis purpurea var. calycosa include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health.
